headline: Peruvian Sol Closes at S/3.415 Amid Central Bank Intervention
summary: The US dollar closed at S/3.415 in the Peruvian foreign exchange market, up 0.21 per cent, despite central bank intervention to moderate exchange rate volatility.
why: Central bank foreign exchange interventions aim to smooth excessive currency fluctuations and stabilize domestic monetary conditions.

impacts.name: US Dollar / Peruvian Sol
impacts.why: Market demand for the US dollar drove the exchange rate higher despite regulatory intervention.
